tumble.description: Winning symbols are removed, remaining symbols collapse, and new symbols drop in until no new win appears.

ante_bet.description: Increases feature frequency and disables Buy Free Spins while active.

rules_pages.title: VAULT 20K
points: Vault 20K by Lumina Games is played on a grid of 6 reels and 5 rows.
Symbols pay anywhere: 8 or more matching symbols anywhere on the grid win. The pay depends on the number of matching symbols, as shown in the Paytable.
Wins of different symbols are added together. All pays are multiplied by the bet.

rules_pages.title: TUMBLE
points: After every win the winning symbols are removed, the remaining symbols fall down and new symbols fill the empty positions.
Tumbling continues until no new win appears. All wins of a tumble sequence are added together.

rules_pages.title: MULTIPLIERS
points: Multiplier symbols with values from 2x to 1000x can land on any spin or tumble.
Base game: when a tumble sequence ends with a win, the values of all multiplier symbols that landed in that sequence are added together, and the win of the sequence is multiplied by that sum.

Free Spins: the values of multiplier symbols that land in a winning tumble sequence are added to a total multiplier, which then multiplies the win of that sequence. A winning sequence on which no multiplier symbol lands is paid without the total multiplier. Multipliers in a sequence without a win are not added.

rules_pages.title: FREE SPINS
points: 4 or more Scatter symbols anywhere on the grid award 15 Free Spins. Scatters also pay as shown in the Paytable.
During Free Spins, 3 or more Scatter symbols award 5 additional Free Spins.
During Free Spins, symbol and Scatter pays are as shown in the Free Spins paytable.

rules_pages.title: ANTE BET AND BUY FREE SPINS
points: Ante Bet raises the cost of each spin to 1.25x the bet and increases the chance of triggering Free Spins naturally. Buy Free Spins is not available while Ante Bet is active.
Buy Free Spins: for 100x the bet, a spin is played that is guaranteed to land at least 4 Scatter symbols and award 15 Free Spins.

rules_pages.title: MAXIMUM WIN
points: The maximum win is 20000x the bet.

In a Free Spins round, the total win of the round, including the spin that triggered it, is capped at 20000x the bet. When the cap is reached, the round ends immediately and any remaining Free Spins are forfeited.

rules_pages.title: GAME PARAMETERS
points: Malfunction voids all pays and plays.
